summary: Full **Documents** archive (`board` & `admin` only, Fase 3): CRUD `/api/v1/documents` with multipart upload using **flat form fields + `file`** (max 50 MB, PDF/images/Office), always-protected download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) via Ktor Bearer → `Blob`, filters (`kind`, `eventId`, `userId`, `year`, `q`), and web filterable list + upload UI. **Server + web (wasmJs)**.
overview:
Fase 3 protected document repository for board minutes, invoices, contracts, grants, statutes, insurance policies, and signed RGPD consent forms.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.11, §6.7 (documentos), §6.9 (ficheros protegidos), §7.4 (Documents) · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`documents`, `stored_files`).
- `platform-core-contract` (`Document`, `DocumentKind`, `DocumentPatch`, `FileRef`).
- `platform-server-auth`, `platform-files` (`FileStorageService.storeDocument`, 50 MB PDF/image/Office magic-byte validation, protected download with `Content-Disposition: attachment`), `platform-me-rgpd` (`BrowserFileDownload`), `platform-web-shell` (`SessionManager.fetchAuthorizedBytes`), `platform-openapi-deploy`.

**Key business & security rules (`decisiones.md` & §5.11)**
- **Strictly `board` and `admin` only** (`anonymous` → 401; `member` and `technical` → 403 on all `/api/v1/documents*` endpoints and on protected document file downloads). Never exposed on `/public/*`. (Note: a member can see metadata of their own `userId = me` documents inside `GET /api/v1/me/export` per `decisiones.md`.)
- **Multipart upload contract (`POST /api/v1/documents`, `decisiones.md`):** uses `multipart/form-data` with **individual form fields** (simplest for Ktor Client across Web and future Android clients, plus `curl -F`): `title` (required, max 200), `kind` (required, `DocumentKind` snake_case), `date` (optional `YYYY-MM-DD`), `eventId` (optional), `userId` (optional), `notes` (optional) + `file` (required binary part, max 50 MB, allowed MIME by magic bytes: PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, DOCX, XLSX, ODT, ODS). Subject to the `upload` rate limit (30/min/user).
- **Update (`PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}`):** RFC 7386 JSON Merge Patch with required `version` updating metadata (`title`, `kind`, `date`, `eventId`, `userId`, `notes`). File replacement is done by uploading a new document or deleting/re-uploading (immutable file per document record keeps audit clarity).
- **Deletion (`DELETE /api/v1/documents/{id}`):** removes the `documents` row and deletes the corresponding `stored_files` row + disk file in `FILES_DIR` post-commit (`204`).
- **Authenticated browser download (`decisiones.md`):** because `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/{filename}` requires `Authorization: Bearer` for protected documents (never cookies), clicking «Descarrega» in the webapp fetches bytes via `SessionManager.fetchAuthorizedBytes(doc.file.url)` and triggers a browser download via `BrowserFileDownload.downloadBytes(...)`.
- **Foreign key validation:** when `eventId` or `userId` is provided, verify the referenced row exists (`422 validation_failed` if missing). Documents are preserved when a user is soft-deleted or anonymized (`decisiones.md`).

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- Permission matrix verifies `anonymous` (401), `member` (403), `technical` (403), `board` & `admin` (full CRUD + protected download with `Content-Disposition: attachment`).
- Multipart upload validates required form fields, rejects unsupported MIME (`415`) and > 50 MB (`413`), and links `eventId`/`userId` (reflected in `Event.documentIds` for `board`).
- Deleting a document removes its file from `FILES_DIR`.
- Web UI at `/documents` renders `KpiFilterStrip`, filters (`kind`, `year`, `eventId`/`userId`, search `q`), multipart upload modal, metadata edit dialog, delete confirmation, and Bearer-authenticated download button.
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: All documents UI, ViewModels, and repositories live in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. Uses `SessionManager.fetchAuthorizedBytes` + `BrowserFileDownload` in `wasmJsMain`. Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- Electronic signatures or OCR.
- Public document sharing.
- In-place binary file replacement on `PATCH`.
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: Bearer JWT via `SessionManager`. Tab `/documents` visible only when `documents:read` is present.
auth.server: `board` and `admin` only (`403` for `member` and `technical`). Stored files always have `protected = 1`.

components.name: Documents.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries for filtered/paginated documents (`kind`, `eventId`, `userId`, `year`, `q`, `sort`), join with `stored_files`, optimistic-locked metadata patch, and delete.

components.name: DocumentService
components.usage: Handles multipart create (via `FileStorageService.storeDocument` with `protected = true`), validates `eventId`/`userId` existence, metadata `PATCH` with `version`, and transactional `DELETE` cleaning up `stored_files` + disk blob post-commit.

components.name: DocumentRoutes
components.usage: Mounts all 5 `/api/v1/documents*` endpoints guarded by `requireRole(BOARD, ADMIN)` (with `upload` rate limit on `POST`).

components.name: MuixerangaApi (documents extension)
components.usage: Client methods: `listDocuments`, `getDocument`, `uploadDocument` (`submitFormWithBinaryData` with flat form fields + `file`), `patchDocument`, `deleteDocument`.

components.name: DocumentsRepository + DocumentsViewModel
components.usage: Manages filterable list (`kind`, `year`, `eventId`, `userId`, `q`), multipart upload progress/validation, metadata edit, delete confirmation, and authenticated download via `SessionManager.fetchAuthorizedBytes` + `BrowserFileDownload`.

components.name: DocumentsScreen + DocumentUploadDialog
components.usage: Route `/documents`: `KpiFilterStrip`, filter bar (`kind`, `year`, search), document list/table with kind badge, date, linked event/member, size, «Descarrega», «Edita», «Elimina», and upload dialog using browser file picker (`wasmJsMain` `expect/actual` file picker helper).

structure:
Vertical slice flow:

```text
Web /documents (DocumentsScreen → DocumentsViewModel → DocumentsRepository → MuixerangaApi)
  ├─ Upload: multipart/form-data (title, kind, date?, eventId?, userId?, notes?, file) → POST /api/v1/documents
  └─ Download: GET /api/v1/files/{id}/{name} (Authorization: Bearer) → ByteArray → BrowserFileDownload
Server DocumentRoutes → DocumentService (+ FileStorageService) → Documents.sq (SQLite v0.2)
```

sections.title: Multipart form fields (`POST /api/v1/documents`, `decisiones.md`)
sections.description: Accept flat `PartData.FormItem` fields (`title`, `kind`, optional `date`, optional `eventId`, optional `userId`, optional `notes`) alongside a single `PartData.FileItem` named `file`.
sections.behavior: Read form fields and stream `file` to temp storage via `FileStorageService.storeDocument` (50 MB cap, magic-byte check). If any field validation fails (`422`), clean up the temp file immediately before returning `ApiErrorResponse`.

sections.title: Listing filters & sorting
sections.description: `GET /api/v1/documents` supports `page`, `perPage`, `kind`, `eventId`, `userId`, `year` (matches `date` year or `createdAt` year when `date` is null), `q` (search in `title`, `notes`), and `sort` (`date`, `title`, `createdAt`; default `-date`).
sections.behavior: Every returned `Document` embeds `file: FileRef` (pointing to `/api/v1/files/{id}/{safeName}` and optional `thumbUrl` when the document is an image).

endpoints.name: Upload document
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. `multipart/form-data` with flat fields (`title`, `kind`, `date?`, `eventId?`, `userId?`, `notes?`) + `file` (max 50 MB). `201` + `Location`. Upload rate limit.

endpoints.name: Update document metadata
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. RFC 7386 JSON Merge Patch with `version` (metadata only).

endpoints.name: Delete document
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. `204`; deletes DB row, `stored_files`, and disk file.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 `documents`, `stored_files`, `events`, and `users` via `Documents.sq`. No new migrations.
